svg.title: Quest map
svg.desc: Pixel world map linking five project worlds in order — Merchant Kingdom (BizPilot), Energy Realm (SmartWatts), Incident Dungeon (OpsPilot), Floodlands (BahaRoute), Weather World (Weather Weather Lang) — plus the bonus Rain Observatory (Ulan Ba?) and two side quests, Commerce City (Classic Flagship Store) and Guild Hall (TAPME).
